gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.12152 42.372407)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
tri_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_TRI(rast, 1) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(t.rast, 1, o.pt) AS tri_value
FROM tri_rast t, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-71.12152, 42.372407), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
ruggedness AS (
  SELECT
    ST_TerrainRuggednessIndex(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast,
        ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 1000), -- 1 km buffer for ruggedness index
        TRUE
      ),
      1
    ) AS ruggedness_index
  FROM
    public.dem_us r,
    poi_geom p
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geom::geometry)
)
SELECT
  ruggedness_index
FROM
  ruggedness;
